name: appointment_copay_collection
description: Patient portal page that collects an upcoming appointment's copay on a stored card and posts it to the appointment claim's COPAY line item.

applications.name: Appointment Copays
applications.description: Opens the page where a patient pays the copay for an upcoming appointment.

handlers.description: Serves the copay page, lists upcoming appointments, and emits ChargeStoredCard effects.
Pushes the stored-card charge result to the patient's open copay page.
Lets a logged-in patient subscribe to their own charge-result channel.
